summary: Ballard Power Systems filed a Form 6-K reporting a news release that Solaris Bus & Coach selected Ballard's FCmove-SC fuel cell engine for its next-generation hydrogen bus platform. The filing describes a commercial supplier nomination and an update to an existing long-term supply agreement extended to 2029. No price per share, premium, stake, or deal structure is mentioned. The registrant is a supplier announcing a customer selection, not a party to a M&A, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction.
